JMC Thursday Evening Ride

Ridgeland, MS · Road

JMC Thursday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Ridgeland, MS. Schedule: Thursday evenings; routes and start posted on Facebook, from Parking lot behind Soulshine Pizza, or the office building across from Fleet Feet on Hwy 51. Pace: intermediate to fast (15–24+ mph groups).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate to fast (15–24+ mph groups). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the JMC Thursday Evening Ride group ride

Thursday road rides in Ridgeland with a few route choices. One group usually leaves from behind Soulshine Pizza and another from the office building across from Fleet Feet. Check the club or Madison/Ridgeland Cycling Facebook pages for that week's plan.
